scion-of-the-three.summary: A Rogue empowered, by devotion or by curse, by the Dead Three (Bane, Bhaal and Myrkul), who preys on the wounded and spreads terror.

Bloodthirst.summary: Reaction when an enemy you see within 30 ft is left Bloodied but alive by damage: teleport next to it and make one melee attack. INT modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

Dread Allegiance.summary: Pick one of the Dead Three for a damage Resistance and a cantrip (INT): Bane, Psychic and Minor Illusion; Bhaal, Poison and Blade Ward; Myrkul, Necrotic and Chill Touch. You can switch after a Long Rest.

options.name: Bane
options.summary: Resistance to Psychic; Minor Illusion cantrip.

options.name: Bhaal
options.summary: Resistance to Poison; Blade Ward cantrip.

options.name: Myrkul
options.summary: Resistance to Necrotic; Chill Touch cantrip.

Strike Fear.summary: New Cunning Strike, Terrify (cost 1d6): the target makes a WIS save or is Frightened for 1 minute, giving you Advantage on attacks against it; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

options.name: Terrify
options.summary: Cost 1d6. WIS save or Frightened for 1 minute (repeat the save each turn end); you have Advantage on attacks against it meanwhile.

Aura of Malevolence.summary: When Bloodthirst teleports you, chosen creatures within 10 ft of your start or end space take INT modifier damage of your Dread Allegiance type, ignoring Resistance.

Dread Incarnate.summary: A Short Rest restores one Bloodthirst use, and Sneak Attack dice that roll 1 or 2 count as 3.

options.name: Cutthroat
options.summary: Regain one spent Bloodthirst use on a Short Rest.

options.name: Murderous Intent
options.summary: Treat 1s and 2s on Sneak Attack dice as 3s.
